findingDetails.title: Symlinked docs and packet directories escape the walk-based guard checks while existence checks follow them
findingDetails.case: a routable markdown doc placed under a scanned references/ or assets/ tree as a symlink, or a surface packet directory delivered as a symlink; fs.readdirSync withFileTypes reports isFile() and isDirectory() false for symlink entries, so the walks skip them while onDisk and path-existence checks follow the links
findingDetails.evidence: collectDocs collects only entry.isFile() at verify-doc-claims.cjs:122; walkMarkdown at verify-router-sync.cjs:101 and hubPacketDirs at :108 use the same dirent predicate; no isSymbolicLink or realpath appears in either guard; a Node experiment over a scratch tree printed isFile=false isDir=false isSym=true for a symlinked file and a symlinked directory
findingDetails.userImpact: the leg 1b contract (every routable reference or asset doc is routed) and the paths check can be evaded by a symlink, so drift escapes the completion gate; planting the link needs repository write access and the canonical target is usually walked anyway, so this is a silent untracked-duplicate risk rather than a privilege gain
findingDetails.scopeProof: exact search for the dirent predicates over both guards shows the enumeration sites at verify-router-sync.cjs:100-101, :108, :282-283 and verify-doc-claims.cjs:120, :122, plus zero symlink handling; the existence filter at verify-router-sync.cjs:31-34 uses fs.existsSync, which follows links
findingDetails.recommendation: pick one symlink policy and apply it in both guards: follow links with a cycle guard, or detect symlinked .md/packet entries and report them as drift; if links are followed, resolve realpath before the insideHub containment test at verify-doc-claims.cjs:167
findingDetails.confidence: medium-high on behavior, medium on practical exploitability
findingDetails.downgradeTrigger: a documented decision plus a test asserting symlinked docs are intentionally outside the routable corpus
